newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH GOVT TO REVIEW 1998 BUDGET PLAN ON JUNE 2.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH GOVT TO REVIEW 1998 BUDGET PLAN ON JUNE 2.

text.p: The Finnish government will review on Monday a summary of all ministries' expenditure plans for the 1998 state budget, finance ministry budget chief Erkki Virtanen said on Friday.
"From the point of view of overall fiscal impact, the ministries' proposals are very well in line with the government's spending frame decisions in February," Virtanen told Reuters by telephone.
He forecast total 1998 state budget spending of around 190 billion markka and a deficit in the region of 20 billion markka -- both figures in line with the February decisions.

On February 25, the five-party left-right-green coalition decided that 1998 budget expenditure must not exceed 191 billion markka against 190.3 billion in this year's budget as approved by parliament.

The government said in a statement on Friday it would review on June 2 at 1200/0900 GMT the ministries' budget plans for 1998, a new economic forecast by the finance ministry's economics department, and a new employment report.
The economics department's new forecast would be published on Monday at 1100/0800 GMT, a ministry official said.
